query: What formal privacy controls and synthetic-data rules will we adopt (DP budget if any, identity-risk thresholds, allowed public releases), and who will validate synthetic fidelity and re-identification risk?

response.query: What formal privacy controls and synthetic-data rules will we adopt (DP budget if any, identity-risk thresholds, allowed public releases), and who will validate synthetic fidelity and re-identification risk?
response.answer: We will adopt differential privacy with a budget and set identity-risk thresholds. Public releases will follow strict validation for synthetic fidelity and re-identification risk by our dedicated data security team.
